# Mayank Aggarwal — Digital Marketing & AI Specialist

> Professional portfolio, interactive marketing tools, and technical guides of Mayank Aggarwal, based in Delhi, India.

## About
Mayank Aggarwal is a Digital Marketing & AI Specialist with 1 year of hands-on experience in performance marketing, Meta Ads management, generative AI video production (Runway Gen-3, Kling AI), and short-form content strategy. He holds a B.Com (Hons) degree from Shaheed Bhagat Singh College, University of Delhi, and operates under the agency brand Klikwise.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **Performance Marketing (Meta Ads):** Account structure, Pixel/CAPI setup, Advantage+ campaigns, and creative testing for D2C and service businesses.
- **Social Media Management:** 30-day content calendar execution, reel scripting, and brand authority positioning.
- **AI Video & Filmmaking:** Generative promotional videos and UGC ads using Runway Gen-3 Alpha, Kling AI, and sound design.
- **AI Voiceover & Audio Design:** Neural voice narration using ElevenLabs Multilingual v2 with commercial audio clearance.
- **AI Images & Creative Branding:** Midjourney v6.1 prompt engineering, static ad variations, and graphic design assets.
- **Content & Reel Strategy:** 3-second hook formulas, retention pacing, and short-form video frameworks.
- **SEO & AEO Architecture:** Keyword mapping, on-page schema structuring, and high-intent topical clusters.

## Published Playbooks & Articles (50 Comprehensive Guides)
- [How to Start Meta Ads for a Small Business in India (Step by Step)](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/how-to-start-meta-ads-small-business-india): To launch Meta Ads in India effectively, avoid the 'Boost Post' button. Instead, set up Meta Business Suite and Ads Manager, install the Meta Pixel on your website, create a Sales or Leads campaign objective, configure manual placements for Instagram Reels and Stories, and begin with a testing budget of ₹500 to ₹1,000 per day spread across 3 creative variations.
- [Meta Ads Pixel and Conversions API Setup: A Beginner's Checklist](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/meta-ads-pixel-conversions-api-setup-checklist): The Meta Pixel alone loses 15% to 30% of conversion data due to iOS privacy constraints, ad blockers, and browser cookie restrictions. To fix this, implement the Meta Conversions API (CAPI) alongside the browser Pixel. This creates a hybrid server-to-browser tracking setup that deduplicates events and restores accurate ROAS attribution.
- [Meta Advantage+ Shopping Campaigns (ASC): Setup Guide for 2026](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/meta-advantage-plus-shopping-campaigns-guide): Advantage+ Shopping Campaigns (ASC) use AI automation to consolidate prospecting and retargeting into a single campaign. To make ASC profitable in 2026, set an existing customer budget cap between 10% and 15%, feed at least 15 to 20 diverse creatives (video reels, carousels, customer reviews), and let machine learning distribute spend dynamically.
- [How to Reduce Meta Ads Cost Per Lead (CPL) in India (Proven Tactics)](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/how-to-reduce-meta-ads-cpl-india): Reducing Cost Per Lead (CPL) on Meta Ads in India while keeping lead quality high requires three adjustments: switch to Instant Forms with 'Higher Intent' review steps, add 2 custom qualifying multiple-choice questions, and trigger instant WhatsApp confirmation messages within 5 minutes of form submission.
- [Facebook Ad Account Disabled? How to Appeal and Recover in 2026](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/facebook-ad-account-disabled-appeal-recovery): When a Meta ad account is restricted, do not panic or immediately create a new account from the same browser. Check Account Quality, identify the flagged policy violation (misleading claims, unverified payment, or page feedback score), and submit a structured appeal through Meta Business Support chat with government ID verification.
- [Meta Custom and Lookalike Audiences: The Complete 2026 Strategy](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/meta-ads-custom-audiences-lookalike-strategy): In a privacy-first marketing landscape, first-party custom audiences provide your strongest competitive advantage. Build high-value customer lists segmented by purchase frequency, generate 1% to 3% Lookalikes from top-tier lifetime value (LTV) customers, and create 60-day Instagram engagement retargeting pools.
- [B2B Lead Generation on Meta Ads: How to Get High-Ticket Clients](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/b2b-lead-generation-meta-instant-forms): B2B lead generation on Meta Ads succeeds when you treat Facebook and Instagram as executive discovery platforms. Target founders and directors during evening scroll hours, lead with authoritative industry breakdown assets, and qualify prospects using custom fields before scheduling discovery calls.
- [COD vs Prepaid in Indian E-Commerce: How to Optimize Meta Ads](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/cod-vs-prepaid-e-commerce-meta-ads-india): Cash on Delivery (COD) drives 60% of Indian e-commerce volume but carries painful 25% to 40% Return-to-Origin (RTO) rates. To improve margins on Meta Ads, test prepaid discounts (₹100 off or 10% instant discount via UPI), require WhatsApp OTP confirmation on COD orders, and optimize ad copy around verified prepaid perks.
- [Meta Ads Creative Fatigue: The 7-Day Testing and Refresh Framework](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/meta-ads-creative-fatigue-testing-framework): Creative fatigue occurs when ad frequency rises and click-through rates (CTR) plummet as target audiences tire of seeing the same visual. To maintain stable ROAS, implement a 7-day creative testing sandbox: test 3 new hook angles weekly, promote winning variations to your scaling campaign, and retire decaying ads fast.
- [ROAS vs MER: Which Growth Metric Actually Matters in 2026?](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/roas-vs-mer-which-marketing-metric-matters-2026): In-platform ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) is frequently distorted by view-through attribution and platform self-reporting. Marketing Efficiency Ratio (MER = Total Store Revenue / Total Marketing Spend) offers a clean, unvarnished measure of business health and profitability across all acquisition channels.
- [Google Performance Max (PMax) Campaigns: The 2026 E-Commerce Scaling Guide](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/google-performance-max-pmax-scaling-guide): Google Performance Max (PMax) uses multi-channel machine learning across Search, YouTube, Display, Discover, and Gmail. To scale profitably in 2026 without burning budget on low-intent display junk, segment asset groups by product margin, apply account-level negative brand keyword lists, and feed first-party customer match lists for algorithmic training.

To capture enterprise decision-makers in New York, London, and San Francisco, build tight exact-match keyword clusters around commercial intent terms ('software', 'pricing', 'enterprise platform'), introduce qualifying form friction, and pass CRM revenue data back via Google Enhanced Conversions.
